not_exported.detail: these servers aren't in the workspace's MCP server list, so export can't tell how they sign in: https://docs.langchain.com/mcp
Fleet's built-in skills (presentation-builder, svg-builder, mermaid-diagram-builder, generate-skill, fleet-guide and others) ship with Fleet's runtime. The exported agent doesn't have them.
Fleet returned no files for these linked workspace skills: summarizer
MDA has no equivalent yet: aws_bedrock_guardrail

warnings: Model: the Fleet agent runs on Fleet's default model, which MDA can't run, so export wrote MDA's default `openai:gpt-6-luna`.
Middleware: Fleet didn't confirm it returned this agent's guardrails. Check the agent's middleware in Fleet.
left_behind: Conversations: past threads stay in Fleet. The deployment starts with none.
Sharing: people you shared the agent with in Fleet don't get access to the deployment.
Credentials: saved logins don't carry over. Each user signs in again the first time a tool needs it.
Traces: the deployment traces to a new LangSmith project. Past traces stay in the Fleet agent's project.
sandbox: Couldn't read Fleet access profile `pol-1` (it may have been deleted), so its settings couldn't be carried over to `sandbox/__init__.py`. If you still need them, check the profile in Fleet and add them to `sandbox/__init__.py`.
skills: `mda deploy` uploads these skills from `skills/`: triage.
The agent can't edit its skills anymore. In Fleet it could save what it learned into them; it now saves to `memories/agent/` instead.
memory: `memory.py` gives the agent its own memory in `memories/agent/`. It starts empty, and the agent adds to it as it learns.
